{{Infobox auto|type=[[Fish]]}}
A '''freshwater puffer''' is a common ⭐☆☆☆ [[fish]] caught by [[fishing]] in [[Fishing#Arid freshwater|arid freshwater]]. It cooks into [[Cooked Pufferfish|cooked pufferfish]], and a [[Fisherman]] buys 12 of them for an [[Obol]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
The freshwater puffer can be caught in this table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/freshwater_hot_dry.json}}</ref> The chances are per cast of a [[Fishing Rod|fishing rod]] and include the junk and treasure rolls.
{| class="wikitable"
! Climate !! Biomes !! Weight !! Per catch (open water) !! Per catch (other water) !! Per catch ({{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III)
|-
| [[Fishing#Arid freshwater|Arid freshwater]] || Savanna, Desert, Badlands, Wooded Badlands, Savanna Plateau, Eroded Badlands, Windswept Savanna || 15 of 42 || 30.36% || 31.95% || 30.19%
|}

The same tables are also rolled by the fisherman's house chest in [[Village|villages]] and by the {{MCW|Elder Guardian|elder guardian}}'s drops, using the biome at the chest or where the elder guardian dies.

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
The freshwater puffer keeps the vanilla pufferfish's effects when eaten raw: {{EffectLink|Poison}} II for 1:00, {{EffectLink|Hunger}} III for 0:15 and {{EffectLink|Nausea}} for 0:15. It heals nothing. Cooking it into [[Cooked Pufferfish|cooked pufferfish]] removes the poison and adds [[Conduit Power]].

=== Cooking ===
{{Cooking|station=Oven|Input=Freshwater Puffer|Output=Cooked Pufferfish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Kindling|Input=Freshwater Puffer|Output=Cooked Pufferfish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Mud Kiln|Input=Freshwater Puffer|Output=Charred Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}}

The recipes match any <code>minecraft:pufferfish</code>, so every pufferfish gives the same result.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_pufferfish.json}}</ref> A [[Mud Kiln]] burns it into [[Charred Fish|charred fish]] instead.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
Because it is a pufferfish underneath, it can be used in [[Bokguk|bokguk]], which takes any pufferfish.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/bokguk.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Fisherman]] buys 12 caught freshwater puffer for 1 [[Obol]] once he reaches Apprentice level. Only fish with the ⭐☆☆☆ rarity line, which the fishing loot tables add, are accepted.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fisherman/2/freshwater_pufferfish.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Angler's Almanac ==
The [[Angler's Almanac]] has an entry for the freshwater puffer under Arid Freshwater (listed chance 35.7%), unlocked by catching one after the player has obtained the almanac.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> Its description reads:
<blockquote>''A tiny fish that responds to danger by becoming a spiky balloon. Honestly fair.''</blockquote>

== Advancements ==
* '''No More Fish in the Sea''' – catch every fish, including this one. Rewards 10 [[Obol]]s.
* '''Fishmonger''' – sell caught fish to a Fisherman.
